work.description: The operative body concerns cathedral beneficiaries, distinguished from canons, and grants specified dress conditional on the canons’ vesture. This actual beneficiary identity controls the title despite the loose editorial synopsis. Source provenance9271 is own;9342 is the following bull’s citation. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF9263–9263; the source closing at LF9362–9365 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima sexta iunii mille- simo octingentesimo quadragesimo, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo..  Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
